resources.string: The note stays hidden (shown as not found) until this date and time, which must be before the note expires.
The open time must be before the note expires.
Share the passphrase through a different channel than the link. It never leaves this device except inside the encryption.
You get a notification-style record when the note is opened. The recipient is told this before they reveal the note. BurnPony does not do silent read tracking.
The note opens as soon as the link is visited, with no confirmation screen. Some email scanners and link previews visit links automatically and can burn the note before the recipient sees it.
The view is used as soon as the link opens, before the passphrase is entered.
Not available with a read receipt. The recipient has to be told about the receipt before the note opens.
The label stays on this device and appears in Sent Notes and notifications. It is never sent to the server.
Send the passphrase separately, through a different channel than this link. Anyone with both can read the note.
In-person handoff: let the recipient scan this. The full link, key included, transfers without any network.
Expires %1$s. You can burn it early from Sent Notes.
Notes you create appear here with live status. Only the note ID and a management token are stored on this device. The note text is kept only if you choose to keep a copy.
The encrypted note is deleted from the server immediately. Anyone opening the link afterward sees only that the note is unavailable.
Could not burn the note. Try again.
Removes all burned and expired notes from this device. The server copies are already gone.
Could not change the expiration. Try again.

Notes are encrypted on this device with AES-256-GCM before anything is uploaded. The decryption key travels only in the part of the link after the #, which browsers never send to any server. An optional passphrase is stretched with PBKDF2 and mixed into the key. The server stores ciphertext it cannot read, plus a note ID, view count, and expiry. No accounts, no names, no analytics.

Honest limits: whoever has the full link (and passphrase, if set) can read the note. A recipient can always copy or photograph a note while it is visible. Self-destruction limits future access; it does not control the moment of reading.
The whole server is open source and runs on any shared PHP host. Point this at your own instance and BurnPony never talks to ours. Notes remember which server they were created on.
Enter a full URL like https://notes.example.com
BurnPony is part of the pony family of privacy tools: encryption you can inspect instead of taking a developer\'s word for it.

Password manager for pass and age
Hidden messages in photos and text
Route all relay traffic through Tor or a SOCKS5 proxy. When on, a note is created and managed only while the proxy is reachable.
Orbot isn\'t installed. Install it from F-Droid or Google Play to route through Tor.
When the proxy is unreachable, requests fail rather than falling back to a direct connection.
With Tor, a username and password put BurnPony on its own circuit, separate from other apps (stream isolation). For a custom proxy that requires a login, use its credentials.
Each compartment has its own passphrase. Handing over one reveals only that compartment; no one can prove the others exist.
Add at least two compartments with text.
Every compartment needs its own passphrase.
Each compartment needs a different passphrase.
Protect each key with a passphrase
Any %1$d of %2$d keys, combined in the viewer, open the note.
Double-bottom notes use at least two views, so a compartment can be opened under pressure and another retrieved later.
Each compartment has its own passphrase. Give each recipient only the one for their compartment, through a different channel than the link.
Send one key link to each person. The note only opens when enough of them are combined in the viewer.
New notes start with these options. Changing an option on one note does not change these defaults. Passphrases are never saved.
Keep a copy of notes I send

Each copy is encrypted to a key held in this phone\'s secure hardware. The hardware only releases it after your fingerprint, face or screen lock, so a copy cannot be opened without unlocking, even by the app. The key never leaves the phone and is never backed up. Double bottom notes are never saved.
New notes will no longer be saved. You can also delete the copies already on this device.
Keep a copy on this device
Double bottom notes are never saved. A copy on your phone would prove the hidden compartment exists.
This copy can\'t be opened on this device.
Set a screen lock to keep saved copies.
Notes with a saved copy are kept. Delete a copy from the note itself.
